授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Database system is used to store and manage data. It provides us guarantees that out data are actually stored in the correct format and can be retrieved fast. Actually, databased system has become the foundation and the core part of many application systems.  A relational database system is one in which data is organized into tables, usually with some relationship between them.  The relational database system is very efficient for storing and managing data and is still the main practical database system.
In this course, the basic concepts of database system, theory and technology of designing the relational database system, and how to utilize relational database system (mainly querying methods) are taught.  The main contents of this course are as below.
1)	Database management system
2)	Optimization of database query
3)	Transaction
4)	Recovery technology
5)	Simultaneous access of relational database
